description: This file contains unit tests for the VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter class, verifying its behavior in handling MQTT messages, topic mappings, and access control scenarios within the Eclipse Hono MQTT adapter implementation.

classes.name: VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter, containing multiple test methods to verify MQTT message handling, topic validation, and access controls.

methods.name: testMapTopicFailsForUnknownEndpoint
methods.description: Tests that publishing to an unknown endpoint in the topic results in a failure with HTTP 404.

methods.name: testMapTopicFailsForQoS2TelemetryMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of QoS 2 telemetry messages.

methods.name: testMapTopicFailsForQoS0EventMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of QoS 0 event messages.

methods.name: testMapTopicFailsForQoS2EventMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of QoS 2 event messages.

methods.name: testOnPublishedMessageFailsForMissingTenant
methods.description: Verifies failure when tenant ID is missing from the topic.

methods.name: testOnPublishedMessageFailsForMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Verifies failure when device ID is missing from the topic.

methods.name: testOnPublishedAuthenticatedMessageFailsForMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Checks failure for missing device ID in an authenticated context.

methods.name: testOnPublishedAuthenticatedMessageFailsForNonMatchingTenant
methods.description: Checks that publishing from a device with a tenant different from the one in the topic is rejected.

methods.name: testMapTopicSupportsShortAndLongTopicNames
methods.description: Validates support for different topic naming conventions, including short and long forms.

methods.name: givenAnAdapter
methods.description: Initializes a mock adapter instance for testing.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a mock MQTT publish message with specified QoS and topic.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Constructs a new MQTT context for testing with given parameters.
